blocking_findings.description: The rubric requires a test that fails when each new validator is deleted. ClipOrigin.contract, FirstView.contract and BindingContext.contract lack such tests. Every exercised origin has consistent origin/plan fields and an original clip; every exercised view/context has correctly typed pins. The forged-context test exercises stored chronology, while duplicate-origin and concurrent-view tests exercise separate admission checks. Removing these model validators therefore leaves those tests satisfied. In particular, no test independently proves rejection of PLANNED without a plan, FOUND with a plan, a non-original origin clip, or wrong-kind view/context pins. This conclusion follows from the inspected test inputs and control flow; full runtime mutation testing was unavailable.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Add focused constructor and copied-model admission cases for these validators, using otherwise valid fixtures, existing referenced artifacts with correct digests, and fresh record IDs. Assert the specific validation error and message, verify nonadmission where applicable, and demonstrate that deleting each validator makes its corresponding test fail. Replace broad rejection assertions in the new tests with targeted errors.

claims_for_research.claim: Pydantic v2 model_copy(update=...) does not validate supplied update values.
Pydantic 2.13.5 JsonValue uses list, dict, string, boolean, integer, float and null alternatives, without a tuple alternative.
SQLite permits one simultaneous write transaction; BEGIN IMMEDIATE starts one immediately or can fail with SQLITE_BUSY.
SQLite trigger RAISE(ABORT, message) terminates the triggering statement and returns SQLITE_CONSTRAINT with the supplied message.
Python 3.12 hashlib includes sha256 and hexadecimal output through hexdigest.
RFC 8785 sorts JSON object property names by UTF-16 code units and requires UTF-8 output encoding.
OSXExperts publishes the executable checksum values attributed to its checksum page; current download correspondence is explicitly unverified.
FFprobe decoded timestamps and time bases support variable-rate frame addressing independently of rounded average FPS.
FFmpeg -noautorotate disables automatic rotation, explicit mapping selects the specified stream, and select's n is the zero-based filter-input frame number.
FFmpeg can fall back from a requested pixel format.
